tok 1.0 "University enrollment"

pool uni "University"
  lane student "Student"
    start begin "Application needed"
    task submit "Submit the application online"
    task confirm "Confirm enrollment"
    task getid "Obtain the student ID card"
    task meet "Meet with an academic advisor"
    task select "Select courses"
    task resolve "Resolve schedule conflicts"
    task attend "Attend classes"
    xor change "Change courses?"
    task adddrop "Add or drop courses"
    xor changed
    task reviewg "Review the grades online"
    xor grievance "Grievance?"
    task form "Submit an appeal form"
    task meetc "Meet with the appeals committee"
    task await "Await a decision"
    xor griefjoin
    xor done "Graduated or withdrawn?"
    end finished "Process finished"
    end cancelled "Application canceled"
  lane admissions "Admissions office"
    task review "Review the application and supporting documents"
    xor complete "Documents complete?"
    task notify "Notify the applicant to provide the missing items"
    xor reviewin
    and split
    task evaluate "Evaluate the application"
    and joined
    xor accepted "Application accepted?"
    task accept "Send an acceptance letter"
    task reject "Send a rejection letter"
    xor confirmed "Enrollment confirmed by the deadline?"
    task cancel "Cancel the application"
    task orient "Send orientation materials"
    and split2
    and joined2
    task post "Post the grades"
    end rejected "Application rejected"
  lane finance "Finance department"
    task fees "Process application fees or waivers"
  lane it "IT department"
    task accounts "Set up student accounts"
  lane intl "International student office"
    xor isintl "International student?"
    task visa "Assist with visa processing"
    xor intljoin
